items.description: Laptop damage payment — cracked screen and corner impact damage
items.rationale: Covered under 2.6.1/2.6.2 (evasive manoeuvre in car); one unit, one loss. Repair (screen ~800 + corner ~340, per Case 2) roughly equals or exceeds new price, so 7.1.10 caps at acquisition cost of EUR 1,400 less salvage; deductible not stated.
